import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0

M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1

P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2

V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aas=L[0].split(); B62={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for a,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],a)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8); M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        r1=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(r1,s2[j-1])
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); M[i,j]=c[k]+s; P[i,j,0]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); X[i,j]=c[k]; P[i,j,1]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); Y[i,j]=c[k]; P[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]))); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=P[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');st=P[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=P[i,j,2];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
aa3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
        'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse_pdb(txt):
    at=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append((ln[12:16].strip(),ln[17:20].strip(),ln[21],int(ln[22:26]),
                       float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(at,columns=['name','res','ch','num','x','y','z'])
S=parse_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2A9S.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text)
A=S[S.ch=='A']
cen=np.mean([A[(A.num==v)&(A.name==nm)][['x','y','z']].values[0] for v,nm in [(31,'OG'),(58,'OH'),(63,'NZ'),(145,'CZ')]],axis=0)
sca=A[~A.name.isin(['N','CA','C','O'])]
d=np.linalg.norm(sca[['x','y','z']].values-cen,axis=1)
shells={c:sorted(set(sca.num.values[d<c])) for c in (6.0,7.0,8.0,9.0)}
caA=A[A.name=='CA']; obsA="".join(aa3to1.get(r,'X') for r in caA.res); numsA=list(caA.num)
num2res={n:aa3to1.get(caA[caA.num==n].res.iloc[0],'X') for n in numsA}
for c,v in shells.items(): print(f"shell {c} A: n={len(v)} ->", [f"{num2res[n]}{n}" for n in v])

# sequences
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",headers=H,timeout=240,
    params={"query":'(xref:pfam-PF02464) AND (taxonomy_id:286)',"fields":"accession,organism_name,sequence","size":500,"format":"json"})
recs=r.json()['results']; link=r.headers.get('Link','')
while 'rel="next"' in link:
    nxt=re.search(r'<([^>]+)>; rel="next"',link).group(1)
    r=requests.get(nxt,headers=H,timeout=240); recs+=r.json()['results']; link=r.headers.get('Link','')
uniq={}
for x in recs: uniq.setdefault(x['sequence']['value'],(x['primaryAccession'],x['organism']['scientificName']))
P3298="MARDPVLAVLGYLKDHHLVLTTAESCTAGCMVALLAAFPGTGEVLESGYVVYSPSAKKRLLGVSAETIERYGLTSEPVAWEMALGALKDSDANVVIATTGLAGPDPASGVLPGTLCFAWAFAGEPTALFTRTQRFFGERAQVMHDGAVYGLTRLIHYHERWLRGERA"
P1628="MDPITTLATRLGEHLRRFNAQVTTAESCTGGGIAEAITRIPGSSAWFEAGYVTYSNAQKTRQLGVPEALFGQVGAVSQEVVEAMVRGAQAASGARFAVAVSGVAGPDGGSPAKPVGTVWLAWGDGDRVFSERRQFDGDREAVRRQTVIAALDGLLQLGAE"
def kmer(s,k=3): return collections.Counter(s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1))
def cosim(c1,c2):
    ks=set(c1)|set(c2); v1=np.array([c1.get(x,0) for x in ks],float); v2=np.array([c2.get(x,0) for x in ks],float)
    return float(v1@v2/(np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v2)))
c3,c1k=kmer(P3298),kmer(P1628)
items=[(s,a,o,'PP_3298-like' if cosim(kmer(s),c3)>cosim(kmer(s),c1k) else 'PP_1628-like') for s,(a,o) in uniq.items()]
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); sub=[]
for cl in ['PP_3298-like','PP_1628-like']:
    pool=[x for x in items if x[3]==cl]; idx=rng.permutation(len(pool))[:40]; sub+=[pool[i] for i in idx]
sub+= [(P3298,'Q88HQ5','P. putida KT2440','PP_3298-like'),(P1628,'Q88ME5','P. putida KT2440','PP_1628-like')]
POS=shells[9.0]
rows=[]
for s,a,o,cl in sub:
    a1,a2=nw(obsA,s); i=j=0; mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': i+=1
        if c2!='-': j+=1
        if c1!='-': mp[numsA[i-1]]=c2
    rows.append(dict(acc=a,org=o,clade=cl,**{f"{num2res[n]}{n}":mp.get(n,'-') for n in POS}))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nn per clade:", D.clade.value_counts().to_dict())
cols=[f"{num2res[n]}{n}" for n in POS]
summ=[]
for n in POS:
    col=f"{num2res[n]}{n}"; ref=num2res[n]
    g1=D[D.clade=='PP_1628-like'][col]; g3=D[D.clade=='PP_3298-like'][col]
    summ.append(dict(position=col, shell6=n in shells[6.0], shell7=n in shells[7.0], shell8=n in shells[8.0],
                     PP1628_clade_match=round(100*(g1==ref).mean()),
                     PP3298_clade_match=round(100*(g3==ref).mean()),
                     PP1628_clade_top=g1.value_counts().index[0]+f"({round(100*g1.value_counts().iloc[0]/len(g1))}%)",
                     PP3298_clade_top=g3.value_counts().index[0]+f"({round(100*g3.value_counts().iloc[0]/len(g3))}%)",
                     PP_3298=D[D.acc=='Q88HQ5'][col].iloc[0], PP_1628=D[D.acc=='Q88ME5'][col].iloc[0]))
Sm=pd.DataFrame(summ)
pd.set_option('display.width',260); pd.set_option('display.max_rows',60)
print("\nPocket position conservation by clade (reference = A. fabrum PncC 2A9S):")
print(Sm.to_string(index=False))
Sm.to_csv('pocket_clade_conservation.csv',index=False)
D.to_csv('pocket_clade_raw.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.6))
x=np.arange(len(Sm))
ax.bar(x-0.19,Sm.PP1628_clade_match,0.36,label=f"PP_1628-like clade (n={(D.clade=='PP_1628-like').sum()})",color='#3b6ea5')
ax.bar(x+0.19,Sm.PP3298_clade_match,0.36,label=f"PP_3298-like clade (n={(D.clade=='PP_3298-like').sum()})",color='#c4622d')
for i,r in Sm.iterrows():
    if r.position[0]+str(0) and r.position in ['S31','Y58','K63','R145']:
        ax.text(i,103,"*",ha='center',fontsize=14)
